INSERT INTO analytics_event (day, visitor_id, session_id, new_visitor, name, page_type, path, ref_type, device, plan_id, post_id, duration_ms, props) VALUES
(#{e.day}, #{e.visitorId}, #{e.sessionId}, #{e.newVisitor}, #{e.name}, #{e.pageType}, #{e.path}, #{e.refType}, #{e.device}, #{e.planId}, #{e.postId}, #{e.durationMs}, CAST(#{e.propsJson} AS JSONB))

INSERT INTO stat_daily_visit (day, device, ref_type, visitors, new_visitors, sessions, page_views) SELECT #{day}, COALESCE(device, 'ALL'), COALESCE(ref_type, 'ALL'), count(DISTINCT visitor_id), count(DISTINCT visitor_id) FILTER (WHERE new_visitor), count(DISTINCT session_id), count(*) FILTER (WHERE name = 'page_view') FROM analytics_event WHERE day = #{day} GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((device, ref_type), (device), (ref_type), ()) HAVING count(*) > 0

INSERT INTO stat_daily_page (day, device, page_type, views, visitors, engage_ms, engage_count) SELECT #{day}, COALESCE(device, 'ALL'), page_type, count(*) FILTER (WHERE name = 'page_view'), count(DISTINCT visitor_id) FILTER (WHERE name = 'page_view'), COALESCE(sum(duration_ms) FILTER (WHERE name = 'engage'), 0), count(*) FILTER (WHERE name = 'engage') FROM analytics_event WHERE day = #{day} AND name IN ('page_view', 'engage') GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((device, page_type), (page_type))

INSERT INTO stat_daily_plan (day, device, plan_id, views, visitors, clicks, outbounds) SELECT #{day}, COALESCE(device, 'ALL'), plan_id, count(*) FILTER (WHERE name = 'page_view' AND page_type = 'PLAN'), count(DISTINCT visitor_id) FILTER (WHERE name = 'page_view' AND page_type = 'PLAN'), count(*) FILTER (WHERE name = 'click'), count(*) FILTER (WHERE name = 'page_view' AND page_type = 'OUT') FROM analytics_event WHERE day = #{day} AND plan_id IS NOT NULL AND name IN ('page_view', 'click') GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((device, plan_id), (plan_id))

INSERT INTO stat_daily_interest (day, device, dim, value, cnt) WITH e AS ( SELECT * FROM analytics_event WHERE day = #{day} ), base AS ( SELECT device, 'CALC_DATA' AS dim, props->>'gb' AS value FROM e WHERE name = 'calc' UNION ALL SELECT device, 'CALC_NETWORK', props->>'network' FROM e WHERE name = 'calc' UNION ALL SELECT device, 'CALC_ZERO', (props->>'gb') || '|' || (props->>'network') FROM e WHERE name = 'calc' AND props->>'found' = 'false' UNION ALL SELECT device, 'PARTNER_TAB', props->>'value' FROM e WHERE name = 'filter' AND props->>'dim' = 'partner_tab' UNION ALL SELECT device, 'INTERNET_TAB', props->>'value' FROM e WHERE name = 'filter' AND props->>'dim' = 'internet_tab' UNION ALL SELECT device, 'CLICK_POS', props->>'pos' FROM e WHERE name = 'click' UNION ALL SELECT x.device, d.dim, d.value FROM e x JOIN plan p ON p.id = x.plan_id JOIN plan_version v ON v.id = p.published_version_id CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('VIEW_NETWORK', v.network), ('VIEW_GEN', v.generation), ('VIEW_TYPE', p.plan_type), ('VIEW_PARTNER', p.partner_code), ('VIEW_DATA', CASE WHEN v.data_gb IS NULL THEN 'U' WHEN v.data_gb < 5 THEN 'LT5' WHEN v.data_gb < 10 THEN '5_10' WHEN v.data_gb < 30 THEN '10_30' WHEN v.data_gb < 100 THEN '30_100' ELSE 'GE100' END), ('VIEW_PRICE', CASE WHEN COALESCE(v.monthly_price, v.charge_price) < 10000 THEN 'LT1' WHEN COALESCE(v.monthly_price, v.charge_price) < 20000 THEN '1_2' WHEN COALESCE(v.monthly_price, v.charge_price) < 30000 THEN '2_3' WHEN COALESCE(v.monthly_price, v.charge_price) < 40000 THEN '3_4' ELSE 'GE4' END) ) AS d(dim, value) WHERE x.name = 'page_view' AND x.page_type = 'PLAN' UNION ALL SELECT x.device, d.dim, d.value FROM e x JOIN internet_product ip ON ip.id = (x.props->>'id')::BIGINT CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('INTERNET_CARRIER', ip.carrier), ('INTERNET_TYPE', ip.product_type)) AS d(dim, value) WHERE x.name = 'page_view' AND x.page_type = 'OUT' AND x.props->>'kind' = 'internet' AND x.props->>'id' ~ '^[0-9]{1,18}$' UNION ALL SELECT s.device, 'SEARCH_ENGINE', s.engine FROM ( SELECT min(device) AS device, COALESCE(max(props->>'engine'), 'unknown') AS engine FROM e WHERE ref_type = 'SEARCH' AND name = 'page_view' GROUP BY session_id ) s UNION ALL SELECT f.device, 'SEARCH_LANDING', f.page_type FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (session_id) device, page_type FROM e WHERE ref_type = 'SEARCH' AND name = 'page_view' ORDER BY session_id, occurred_at, id ) f ) SELECT #{day}, COALESCE(device, 'ALL'), dim, left(value, 50), count(*) FROM base WHERE value IS NOT NULL AND value <> '' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((device, dim, left(value, 50)), (dim, left(value, 50)))

INSERT INTO stat_daily_content (day, device, post_id, views, visitors, completes, engage_ms, engage_count, plan_clicks) SELECT #{day}, COALESCE(device, 'ALL'), post_id, count(*) FILTER (WHERE name = 'page_view'), count(DISTINCT visitor_id) FILTER (WHERE name = 'page_view'), count(DISTINCT session_id) FILTER (WHERE name = 'read_complete'), COALESCE(sum(duration_ms) FILTER (WHERE name = 'engage'), 0), count(*) FILTER (WHERE name = 'engage'), count(*) FILTER (WHERE name = 'click' AND props->>'target' IN ('plan', 'home')) FROM analytics_event WHERE day = #{day} AND page_type = 'AI_POST' AND post_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((device, post_id), (post_id))
mapper.select: SELECT 'TOTAL' AS key, COALESCE(sum(visitors), 0)::BIGINT AS visitors, COALESCE(sum(new_visitors), 0)::BIGINT AS new_visitors, COALESCE(sum(sessions), 0)::BIGINT AS sessions, COALESCE(sum(page_views), 0)::BIGINT AS page_views FROM stat_daily_visit WHERE day BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND device = #{device} AND ref_type = 'ALL'

SELECT ref_type AS key, sum(visitors)::BIGINT AS visitors, sum(new_visitors)::BIGINT AS new_visitors, sum(sessions)::BIGINT AS sessions, sum(page_views)::BIGINT AS page_views FROM stat_daily_visit WHERE day BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND device = #{device} AND ref_type <> 'ALL' GROUP BY ref_type ORDER BY sessions DESC

SELECT device AS key, sum(visitors)::BIGINT AS visitors, sum(new_visitors)::BIGINT AS new_visitors, sum(sessions)::BIGINT AS sessions, sum(page_views)::BIGINT AS page_views FROM stat_daily_visit WHERE day BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND device <> 'ALL' AND ref_type = 'ALL' GROUP BY device ORDER BY device

SELECT d::DATE AS day, COALESCE(v.visitors, 0)::BIGINT AS visitors, COALESCE(v.page_views, 0)::BIGINT AS page_views, COALESCE(p.views, 0)::BIGINT AS plan_views, COALESCE(p.outbounds, 0)::BIGINT AS outbounds, COALESCE(s.sessions, 0)::BIGINT AS search_sessions FROM generate_series(#{from}::DATE, #{to}::DATE, INTERVAL '1 day') AS d LEFT JOIN stat_daily_visit v ON v.day = d::DATE AND v.device = #{device} AND v.ref_type = 'ALL' LEFT JOIN stat_daily_visit s ON s.day = d::DATE AND s.device = #{device} AND s.ref_type = 'SEARCH' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT day, sum(views) AS views, sum(outbounds) AS outbounds FROM stat_daily_plan WHERE day BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND device = #{device} GROUP BY day ) p ON p.day = d::DATE ORDER BY d

SELECT page_type, sum(views)::BIGINT AS views, sum(visitors)::BIGINT AS visitors, sum(engage_ms)::BIGINT AS engage_ms, sum(engage_count)::BIGINT AS engage_count FROM stat_daily_page WHERE day BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND device = #{device} GROUP BY page_type ORDER BY views DESC

SELECT s.plan_id, COALESCE(v.name, '#' || s.plan_id) AS name, p.partner_code, pt.name AS partner_name, p.plan_type, v.network, v.generation, COALESCE(v.monthly_price, v.charge_price) AS price, s.views, s.visitors, s.clicks, s.outbounds FROM ( SELECT plan_id, sum(views)::BIGINT AS views, sum(visitors)::BIGINT AS visitors, sum(clicks)::BIGINT AS clicks, sum(outbounds)::BIGINT AS outbounds FROM stat_daily_plan WHERE day BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND device = #{device} GROUP BY plan_id ) s LEFT JOIN plan p ON p.id = s.plan_id LEFT JOIN plan_version v ON v.id = p.published_version_id LEFT JOIN partner pt ON pt.code = p.partner_code ORDER BY s.views DESC, s.outbounds DESC, s.plan_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT dim, value, sum(cnt)::BIGINT AS cnt FROM stat_daily_interest WHERE day BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND device = #{device} GROUP BY dim, value ORDER BY dim, cnt DESC

SELECT s.post_id, COALESCE(a.title, '#' || s.post_id) AS title, c.name AS category_name, s.views, s.visitors, s.completes, s.engage_ms, s.engage_count, s.plan_clicks FROM ( SELECT post_id, sum(views)::BIGINT AS views, sum(visitors)::BIGINT AS visitors, sum(completes)::BIGINT AS completes, sum(engage_ms)::BIGINT AS engage_ms, sum(engage_count)::BIGINT AS engage_count, sum(plan_clicks)::BIGINT AS plan_clicks FROM stat_daily_content WHERE day BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND device = #{device} GROUP BY post_id ) s LEFT JOIN ai_post a ON a.id = s.post_id LEFT JOIN ai_category c ON c.code = a.category_code ORDER BY s.views DESC, s.post_id LIMIT #{limit}
